description_en: Creates a global IP whitelist template
kebab_example: aliyun dds create-global-security-ip-group --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --global-ig-name aizy --gip-list 27.18.86.18,183.92.40.129 --region cn-hangzhou
name: CreateGlobalSecurityIPGroup

parameters.help_en: The region ID of the instance. You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/61933.html operation to query the most recent region list
parameters.name: region_id

parameters.help_en:
The name of the IP whitelist template. The name must meet the following requirements:

- It can contain lowercase letters, digits, and underscores (\_).

- It must start with a letter and end with a letter or digit.

- It must be 2 to 120 characters in length
parameters.help_zh:
IP白名单模板名称。IP白名单模板名称需满足如下要求：

- 由小写字母、数字、下划线（_）组成。

- 由字母开头、字母或数字结尾。

- 长度为2~120个字符
parameters.name: global_ig_name

parameters.help_en:
The IP addresses in the whitelist template.

> Separate multiple IP addresses with commas (,). You can create up to 1,000 IP addresses or CIDR blocks for all IP address whitelists
parameters.help_zh:
白名单模板内的IP地址。

> 多个IP地址需要用英文逗号隔开，所有IP白名单累积支持添加1000个IP地址或地址段
parameters.name: gip_list
